scope: R2 implementation verification only; no scientific selector, orbit bytes, graph, DEM, R3/R4 rule, window, pair, or territorial rule changes

triggering_blind_run.diagnosis: exact frozen POEORB ZIPs were preseeded into a clean SNAP14 user.home; successful GPT runs commonly emitted no AUX_POEORB filename in stdout/stderr, so the legacy log-request proof became observationally incompatible with local-cache transport repair

allowed_consumption_proof.name: CLEAN_USER_HOME_EXACT_POEORB_CACHE_EXCLUSIVITY_AND_HARD_APPLY_ORBIT_GATE
requirements_all_mandatory: user.home is initially empty before the R2 pair
the side-specific POEORB ZIP is independently downloaded and SHA-256/byte-count/inner-EOF verified against the frozen v0.2 prerequisite before preseed
before each side, the exact verified ZIP is copied to the deterministic SNAP14 POEORB cache path and its SHA-256 is reverified

before GPT, no other AUX_POEORB resource for the relevant Sentinel platform is present anywhere under the clean user.home orbit cache except exact resources already preregistered for earlier side(s) of the same pair
GPT returns zero and the side output exists

after GPT, every AUX_POEORB file present anywhere under the clean user.home orbit cache is either the exact side resource or an exact preregistered resource already introduced by this wrapper for the same pair; no unapproved AUX_POEORB filename may appear
the exact side ZIP remains byte-identical after GPT
stdout/stderr must contain no AUX_POEORB filename different from the exact frozen side resource
the frozen graph hash, orbitType and continueOnFail=false are rechecked at runtime
allowed_consumption_proof.pass_semantics: when all requirements pass, exact canonical POEORB consumption is accepted as implementation-verified even if SNAP14 emits no orbit filename because the resource was satisfied from its local cache
allowed_consumption_proof.fail_semantics: any ambiguity, extra POEORB resource, changed hash, nonzero GPT exit, missing output, graph mismatch, or alternative filename remains BLOCKED; absence of a log filename alone is never sufficient for PASS
allowed_consumption_proof.legacy_log_request_rule: if SNAP14 explicitly logs exactly the frozen resource, that remains valid positive evidence; the local-cache proof is an additional preregistered implementation proof route, not a scientific selector change
